subject: PICTURE clause
notes: LANDED 2026-08-18 (PB66). The one sanctioned two-sign form is the significand's fixed +/- beside the exponent's + (NOTE 3): -9.9(5)E+99 and +9(3).9(2)E+999 classify and edit (the golden's E1 / E2); a CR or DB in the significand (9.99CRE+99, 9.99DBE+99) and a floating sign string (+++9.99E+99) are COBOL1658; the fixed-point mutual exclusion is Analyze's long-standing check.
